peakPricing.effectiveFromSourceQuote: we will adopt peak/off-peak pricing, with off-peak prices set at half of the peak-hour prices ... The new prices will take effect at 16:00 (UTC Time) on August 16, 2026.
peakPricing.sourceQuote: Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday (all other hours are off-peak).

bucketMapping.note: DSH tokenUsage 投影四桶 → 官方价目行的映射。四桶互斥，直接相乘相加即可，不需要再做拆分。

cacheWriteTokens.evidence: 官方价目仅列三行（cache hit / cache miss / output），未单列缓存写入
cacheWriteTokens.implementationRule: DeepSeek 路由下 cacheWriteTokens 不单独计价，也不得按 cacheMiss 价重复计费

deepseek-flash.effectiveFromNote: 官方 Updates 页 2026-09-10：With the release of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, API prices have been reduced accordingly. 未给出具体时刻，故按日期记。

rateHistory.note: V4.1-Flash 发布同时降价；官方未公布降价前的具体单价，故 prices 记 null（未取到），不猜测。
峰谷计费开始生效；该时点前后的具体单价官方更新页未列出。

deepseek-v4-pro.effectiveFromNote: 峰谷计费生效时点。官方脚注 (2)：We have decided to continue providing API services for DeepSeek V4 Pro after September 14, 2026, with the billing method remaining unchanged —— 即 2026-09-14 之后单价不变。

rateHistory.note: 官方声明 V4 Pro 于 2026-09-14 之后继续服务且计费方式不变。prices 记 null 表示「无变化」，不是「未取到」；消费侧应沿用 2026-08-16 起的单价。
峰谷计费开始生效；该时点前的单价官方更新页未列出。

deepseek-v4-flash.billing: served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, billed at the Flash price
deepseek-v4-flash.sourceQuote: Use deepseek-flash as the model name. The legacy names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still accepted, but the corresponding models have been retired, their requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.

deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp.billing: served by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, billed at the Flash price

unknownModelPolicy.rule: 查不到模型或查不到对应档位价时返回 null，绝不回退到任何 default 价、也绝不当 0 处理。
resolverRules: 1) 先按 aliases 归一化模型名（别名优先于 models 直查），避免退役名命中残留条目
3) 再按 UTC 时间 + ISO 星期选 offPeak 或 peak 档
4) 档位对象里字段为 null（未取到）时，该字段视为未定价 → 整体金额返回 null，不得部分计费
5) 全程不使用本机时区，不用 Date 的本地方法

fallbackNote: 本表刻意不提供 default 价格：任何未定价都必须显式暴露为 null，由消费侧显示「未定价」。
